snippet.title: DeckTerra - Official Gameplay Trailer (Updated)
snippet.description:
From a humble settlement to a bustling metropolis, guide your empire through history by drafting, drawing, and dealing powerful cards.

As your deck grows in size, your empire grows in power. Expand, Explore, Exploit, and Exterminate your way to victory in this brand-new 4X Deckbuilding game!

Try the demo today on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760980/DeckTerra/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/wvdGJTmBZa

Get updates on the game by following the developer on social media:
Twitter: https://x.com/Murrdog_Games
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/murrdoggames.bsky.social
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/murray_game_dev/
